releaseNotes: Phone to PC Phase 1: Android Share now sends directly to Smart Life PC Receiver for any shared file type. Shared files are first saved locally in a persistent Pending outbox; if the PC is unavailable, Smart Life keeps them safely on the phone and retries automatically. Multiple-file sharing, boot recovery, existing Connect to PC pairing, Search by Name, Search Content, File Type touch behavior, and Photos swipe navigation are preserved.
